investigation.likely_cause: The /data volume on the subscriber DB server srv-db-01 is 100% full (0.1 GiB free, below the 256 MiB write threshold) because the transaction log archive under /data/txlog_archive has built up, most likely from a catch-up run that wrote 8.5 GiB across 34 files in 15 minutes. The database is refusing writes, which causes the balance and bundle API errors, USSD timeouts and synthetic session failures, and SMS queue growth.
